company.name: Dwolla
company.shortDescription: Dwolla is a fintech company powering innovations with sophisticated account-to-account payment solutions.
company.description: Dwolla is a payment services provider powering innovations with sophisticated account-to-account payment solutions. Dwolla’s modern API simplifies the complex process of integrating with the various payment networks to create a single end-to-end solution–giving businesses the ability to program payments on the same day, next day or in real-time directly to bank accounts. With minimal development, start-ups to Fortune 500 companies can gain efficiency, flexibility and improved cash flow by working with Dwolla.

aiResearchSummary.text: Dwolla is researching systems for increasing security in online transfers by maintaining anonymity of transferors, as described in 'Maintaining security in digital electronic transfers through use of a label.' Additionally, they are developing methods for transferring between accounts without requiring sensitive information, as outlined in 'Reducing information requirements in digital electronic transfers.' These areas focus on secure and efficient account-to-account payment solutions.
